tools.name: calculate_customs_duties
tools.description: Calculates official EU customs duties (Common Customs Tariff / MFN) and import VAT for a given HS code and CIF customs value in EUR.

tools.name: search_customs_nomenclature
tools.description: Recherche textuelle bilingue (FR/EN) dans la nomenclature TARIC via indexation FTS5.

tools.name: resolve_hs_code
tools.description: Resout l arborescence hierarchique et la designation officielle d un code SH6 ou TARIC.

tools.name: check_import_restrictions
tools.description: Checks mandatory EU import restrictions, document codes (CE, REACH, CBAM, CHED), and compliance directives.

tools.name: resolve_cbam_and_antidumping
tools.description: Computes definitive EU anti-dumping duties and CBAM carbon financial obligations for steel, aluminium, and sensitive imports.

tools.name: provision_free_api_key
tools.description: Provisions a free sandbox API key (50 credits) for agents to unlock advanced CBAM carbon calculations and factory-specific anti-dumping duty codes.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_customs_nomenclature" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Recherche textuelle bilingue (FR/EN) dans la nomenclature combinée de l'Union Européenne (codes SH6/TARIC) via indexation FTS5." → after: "Recherche textuelle bilingue (FR/EN) dans la nomenclature TARIC via indexation FTS5."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
